description: Read and manage Grafana dashboards, folders, data sources, alert rules, contact points, annotations, teams, service accounts and snapshots on your own Grafana instance in the current tab. Uses your logged-in Grafana session; Grafana is self-hosted, so the package works on any instance host.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated Grafana user profile including name, email, login, organization, and admin status.

tools.name: get_user_preferences
tools.description: Get the current user's Grafana preferences including theme, home dashboard, timezone, and language.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get the current Grafana organization details including name and address.

tools.name: list_org_users
tools.description: List all users in the current Grafana organization with their roles, email, and last seen time. Supports pagination.

tools.name: list_org_quotas
tools.description: List all resource quotas for the current Grafana organization including limits and current usage for dashboards, data sources, alert rules, etc.

tools.name: search_dashboards
tools.description: Search for dashboards and folders by query, tag, type, or starred status. Returns matching items with metadata.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get a dashboard by its UID. Returns full dashboard metadata including panels, permissions, folder, and version.

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a new dashboard. Provide a title and optionally tags, folder UID, and panel definitions as JSON.

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Update an existing dashboard. Fetches the current version, applies changes (title, tags), and saves with the correct version to avoid conflicts.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Permanently delete a dashboard by its UID. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: star_dashboard
tools.description: Star (favorite) a dashboard by its UID. Starred dashboards appear in the starred section.

tools.name: unstar_dashboard
tools.description: Remove a star from a dashboard by its UID.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List all folders in the Grafana instance. Folders organize dashboards into logical groups. Supports pagination via limit and page parameters.

tools.name: get_folder
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Grafana folder by its UID. Returns the folder title, UID, URL, and metadata.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in Grafana to organize dashboards. Requires a title. Optionally specify a custom UID — if omitted, Grafana auto-generates one.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Permanently delete a Grafana folder by its UID. This also deletes all dashboards contained within the folder. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_datasources
tools.description: List all configured data sources in the Grafana instance. Data sources define connections to backends like Prometheus, InfluxDB, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, and more.

tools.name: get_datasource
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific data source by its UID. Returns the data source name, type, URL, database, access mode, and configuration.

tools.name: list_alert_rules
tools.description: List all provisioned alert rules in the Grafana instance. Alert rules define conditions that trigger alerts when metrics cross thresholds or match expressions.

tools.name: get_alert_rule
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific alert rule by its UID. Returns the rule title, condition, evaluation interval, folder, labels, and notification settings.

tools.name: delete_alert_rule
tools.description: Permanently delete a provisioned alert rule by its UID. This stops the rule from evaluating and removes it from the alerting system. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_contact_points
tools.description: List all provisioned contact points in the Grafana alerting system. Contact points define notification channels (email, Slack, PagerDuty, webhook, etc.) where alerts are sent.

tools.name: list_annotations
tools.description: List annotations in Grafana. Annotations mark points in time on dashboard graphs — useful for correlating deployments, incidents, or other events with metric changes. Filter by dashboard, panel, tags, or time range.

tools.name: create_annotation
tools.description: Create a new annotation in Grafana. Annotations mark points or time ranges on dashboard graphs — useful for recording deployments, incidents, configuration changes, or any event you want to correlate with metrics. Optionally associate with a specific dashboard and panel.

tools.name: delete_annotation
tools.description: Permanently delete an annotation by its numeric ID. This removes the annotation marker from all dashboard graphs. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: search_teams
tools.description: Search for teams in the Grafana instance. Teams group users together for shared dashboard and folder permissions. Supports text search and pagination.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: List all members of a specific team by team ID. Returns each member with their user ID, login, email, and avatar URL.

tools.name: list_service_accounts
tools.description: Search and list service accounts in the Grafana instance. Service accounts are used for API access and automation — each has its own set of API tokens and permissions.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: List all dashboard snapshots in the Grafana instance. Snapshots are point-in-time captures of dashboard data that can be shared externally without requiring Grafana access.
